title: Inspect and extend: Reject invalid rows and summarize categories
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/model.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve positive amount/title validation, category aggregation, and money formatting.
problem: Validation is a gate before a row enters the report. Follow amount/title checks, then trace how category groups and totals are calculated and tested. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/model.ts` and the related project files: src/model.ts; test/model.test.ts; src/screens/ReportsScreen.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to positive amount/title validation, category aggregation, and money formatting.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: This is not a tax, compliance, or accounting rules engine.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Validation is a gate before a row enters the report. Follow amount/title checks, then trace how category groups and totals are calculated and tested.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/model.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
